verdict.rationale: Reducto supports natural-language commands for specific operations (Split's section descriptions, Route's category definitions, Fill/Edit's natural-language instructions) and exposes an official MCP server letting agents invoke parse/extract/split/classify/edit via natural-language reasoning loops, plus a CLI. However, this is more 'schema-driven API with NL config fields' than full conversational/natural-language control of the whole product surface, and there's no independent hands-on evidence confirming smooth NL-driven operation end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of natural-language command usage, evidence of NL control over the CLI or non-MCP workflows, and confirmation that all endpoints (not just a subset) accept free-form NL instructions.
